title: Gum treatment (deep cleaning)
what: With numbing, the dentist cleans the spaces between the teeth and gums, called pockets. Tartar and plaque that cause gum inflammation are removed from there.
why: For gum disease, called periodontitis: gums bleed, pull away from the teeth, form pockets, there is bad breath, and teeth start to get loose.
duration: one visit usually takes 40 to 90 minutes; often the mouth is treated in parts over several visits
tell_doctor: Blood thinners. Do not stop them on your own. Your doctor will decide

prepare.title: Before the visit
prepare.text: Usually a professional teeth cleaning is done first.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat beforehand. After the procedure, your mouth will be numb for a few hours.

prepare.title: Smoking
prepare.text: If you smoke, try not to smoke on the day and after. Gums heal worse.

bring: Dental X-rays, if you have them
steps: The dentist measures the depth of the pockets
The tooth roots under the gum are cleaned with special instruments
Sometimes a healing dressing is put on the gums
You are shown how to care for your gums at home
feel: With numbing: pressure and scraping, but no pain
Afterward, the gums ache for 1 to 3 days
Teeth may become more sensitive to cold
after: Rinse your mouth as your dentist prescribed
Use a soft toothbrush and brush gently
For a few days, avoid very hot, spicy, and hard food
A follow-up in a few weeks. The dentist will measure the pockets again

faq.q: Why do my teeth look longer after the cleaning?
faq.a: The inflammation and swelling went down, so the gum settled to its real level.

faq.q: Can gum disease be cured completely?
faq.a: The inflammation can be stopped. But you need good care at home and regular dental visits.

reminders.text: Gum treatment soon. Eat beforehand, and try not to smoke today.
